findings.evidence: The horns curl upward and inward like crescents rather than sweeping back as the spec asks.
The stance is staggered, with the viewer-left boot set forward of the other, instead of the relaxed symmetric A pose the spec requests.
The arms hang close to the torso at roughly 15-20 degrees, short of the specified 25 degrees, which reduces silhouette separation.
The contact shadow beneath the boots is very faint, so ground contact is weakly anchored.
